The spine is NOT visible: no spine, no back cover and no text anywhere except the front cover. Physically correct perspective like a real product photo on a pure white background, soft natural shadow under it. The book fills about 75% of the frame height and is fully visible, nothing cropped.

A photorealistic close-up of two hands (gender not obvious, simple knitted sleeves) crocheting with a wooden hook and dusty rose yarn, a few neat stitches visible, a basket with colourful yarn balls behind. No faces. Title in deep plum, "ЗА НАЧИНАЕЩИ" in mustard.

1) Title, huge, 2-4 lines: "ПЛЕТЕНЕ НА ЕДНА КУКА ЗА НАЧИНАЕЩИ"
2) Subtitle, smaller, 4-5 lines: "Системата С.Т.Е.П.И. - 12 основни бода и 20 проекта (от ръчичка до бебешко одеяло), със стъпка-по-стъпка снимки и ясни шарки, дори да не си държал/а кука досега."
3) Author name at the bottom of the cover, medium: "МАРИЯ КОСТОВА"
4) Publisher mark at the very bottom centre, small: a simple golden key icon followed by the words "ЗЛАТЕН КЛЮЧ"

- No other text, other logos, watermarks, prices or website addresses anywhere.
